LanguageData.Dominion_Visit_BlockedOccupied: {0} is occupied by {1}. Its people are in no mood to receive visitors.
LanguageData.Dominion_Visit_BlockedSiege: {0} is under siege. Its gates are shut.
LanguageData.Dominion_Visit_BlockedBlockade: {0} is blockaded. Nobody gets in or out.
LanguageData.Dominion_WarOnPlayer_Text: {0} has declared war on you. {1} has had enough of your colony, and their fighters are being called up.\n\nExpect raids and warbands. Allies may answer a call to arms; the War tab shows how it goes.
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_InstantNews_Desc: Every report you have the intel for reaches the colony the moment it happens, instead of travelling by caravan, radio or dispatch. Secrets you do not have the intel for stay hidden.
LanguageData.Dominion_Radio_NoAntenna: No large radio antenna next to it (build one touching the receiver for global coverage).
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_VisitorShuttles_Desc: Summit leaders, envoys and council delegates from factions with spacer tech or better land near your colony in a shuttle instead of walking in from the map edge. They still leave on foot when their visit ends.
